pokedexEntries.rb: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

pokedexEntries.ye: According to an enduring legend, 9 noble saints were united and reincarnated as this POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.go: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

pokedexEntries.si: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

pokedexEntries.cr: It is said to live a thousand years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
